text:
devon: Heads-up — saw a weird charge on console for a streaming session that hit a fallback route and also invoked a toolcall. Looks like tokens doubled in the quota timeline.
maria: ugh. do you have the trace id / session id?
devon: trace=trc_8f3a, session=ssn-1145. repro in staging. primary route timed out and we routed to spot-fallback. stream resumed and client sent a toolcall right before EOF.
anika: important: was the toolcall invoked inside the stream (i.e. inline toolcall) or as a separate follow-up request?
devon: inline — client did streaming messages, then a final chunk with: {"type":"tool_call","name":"invoke-exec","payload":"..."}
ian: console shows tokens charged: 256 at 13:02, but runtime logs show ~128 tokens generated. charging mismatch.
sre-bot: Incident candidate logged: #INC-2026-237 — attach logs.
eng-bot: quick dump of the event we pulled from router:
```
{
  "trace":"trc_8f3a",
  "route_history":["primary-us-east:timeout","fallback-us-west:ok"],
  "stream_sessions":[{"chunks":5,"truncated":true}],
  "toolcall":{"name":"invoke-exec","tokens_est":64},
  "tokens_charged":256
}
```
maria: hmm truncated=true — did the client close the socket mid-chunk? that can produce EOF truncation handling.
dan (pseudonym): does our ledger attribute tokens per-path independently? could both primary and fallback accrue credits for overlapping prefix?
ian: digging — router telemetry records per-path provisional tokens when chunk acknowledged by path. If fallback happened we might have double provisional entries and console UI collapses them incorrectly.
anika: so two things: 1) provisional entries persisted after fallback 2) toolcall accounting might be applied on resume and also when stream finishes -> duplication
devon: reproduction steps I used: 1) enable artificial 150ms delay on primary 2) send a long streaming prompt that triggers toolcall on final chunk 3) cause primary to drop -> fallback to spot pool 4) watch console timeline
maria: can you paste the minimal client commands? also which SDK version? older SDKs send separate toolcall events maybe
devon: curl -> websocket proxy -> payload: \n```\n["msg":"chunk1" \n ... \n{"msg":"final","type":"tool_call","name":"invoke-exec","meta":{"sdk":"js-0.9.2"}}\n```\n
ian: js-0.9.2 is known to emit a separate 'toolcall-complete' ack. that could be double-counted if router treats ack from both routes as distinct confirmations.
anika: proposed short-term fix: console should collapse provisional charges by trace id and de-duplicate toolcall tokens within a single session when route_history length>1. also add UI note: "possible provisional duplicates during fallback".
maria: longer-term: router should only commit provisional tokens from the final route commit event. if primary had provisional ledger entries, they should be reconciled/marked rolled-back on fallback commit.
devon: agreeing. also need to ensure token attribution for truncated chunks: currently runtime charges full chunk even if client closed mid-chunk? logs show chunk_size_claimed=64, actual_emitted=32 in the fallback path.
ian: that suggests our truncation accounting path isn't applying suffix trim when replaying from KV cache during resume. a resumed stream may replay buffered tokens causing duplicate counting.
sre-bot: adding to incident: attach traces and sample client socket dump.
eng-bot: implementation notes: 
- Router: add idempotency key per (trace,stream_chunk_id) for provisional ledger writes.
- Runtime: emit explicit chunk_finalized event only when final EOF confirmed; truncated chunks should emit "partial_tokens" metric.
- Console: timeline UI: merge provisional entries by idempotency key and show a small badge when collapsed.
maria: could we hotfix console first to fix misleading UI? then patch router/accounting logic.
anika: yes hotfix helpful for customers. but accounting must be fixed server-side to avoid actual double charges.
ian: I'll draft a PR for router provisional write de-dupe today. devon — can you attach the full router + runtime logs to the ticket?
devon: uploaded to #inc-2026-237: logs.tar.gz (10MB). includes sample pcap of ws session.
maria: writeup for customer-facing note: keep it short: "We observed a rare double-counting display for streaming sessions that hit route fallback while performing inline tool calls. We're fixing the UI and the underlying accounting; only a small set of staging sessions affected. No action required unless you see unexpected charges — contact support."
anika: add to rollout checklist: 1) schema bump for provisional ledger entries (idempotency_key) 2) migration script to mark historical duplicates for last 48h 3) console feature flag to enable collapsed view
ian: also add metric alerts: sudden delta between runtime.tokens_emitted and billing.tokens_charged > 10% for same trace -> auto-open incident.
eng-bot: sample DB idempotency key proposal: "idempotency::trc_8f3a::chunk_4" (string). hashed for index.
devon: any objections to the plan?
maria: none. priority P2 for customer-facing UI hotfix, P0 for accounting fix if we see confirmed double charges in prod.
ian: I'll start the router PR and post link.
devon: thanks all — will update incident when PRs land. :thumbsup:
